title.narrative: Rehabilitation of dialysis centers in Sudan

description.narrative: - Providing (18) dialysis machines distributed in (7) dialysis centers in 5 states, in the state more than one center for population density - Providing (5) electric generators with a capacity of (100) KVA - Providing (18) sick chairs for patients kidneys.

Contribute to the development and stability of the health service for dialysis patients in Sudan and reduce their waiting period by intensifying dialysis devices, as well as providing chairs for dialysis patients, as well as providing electric generators. Project outputs
To fill the great shortage of dialysis centers in hospitals and health centers in the Republic of Sudan, and to help alleviate the suffering of our sick Sudanese brothers there.
